description: API for communicating with a Camunda 8 cluster.  ## Conventions  ### Enum value casing  Server-side, enum-typed request fields accept any casing of a documented value (for example `ACTIVE`, `active`, and `Active` are all accepted on input). This permissive request behavior is a server-side convenience and is **not** part of the OpenAPI enum contract — SDKs generated from this specification by strict generators may reject non-canonical casing on the client side. For portability across SDKs, always send the canonical casing shown in this document.
